title: The Sonny Test: my method for checking an AI agent's "done", and its sealed record
description: When an AI agent says it's done, how do you know it's true? A check passes the Sonny Test only if its verdict comes from a record the AI being tested can't change, and only if it has already caught a fault planted on purpose. This record holds the method, its name, and my history with it, sealed with OpenTimestamps on 3 October 2026 and confirmed in Bitcoin blocks 969668 to 969672. The files are published exactly as sealed.
